current_assessment.scope: Whether the natural-versus-rational appetite crux discriminates the purity family: mode (what fixes a favouring) versus formal object (what measures it), under one standard applied to both forms
current_assessment.assessment: The crux joins two coordinates. The purity family needs only the object coordinate: 05a4e794 reaches horn A's conclusion 7fca65ec (already closed by other routes; a conditional bundle with three open premises, no closure change) from the per-bearer bridge 2306492a and the object premise f2e8eb42, neither of which mentions a mode, and the D-directed rival accepts the per-bearer measure and denies only f2e8eb42. The formal object is indexed by the bearer: one profile (dNature = determinedWill) is measured by D for a natural bearer and by the good for a willing one. GoodGeneral and the route's premises do not encode mode; whether a non-apprehensive state can carry value variation is the disputed step d1fb6414 / 3b40009e, which the encoding neither shows nor excludes. Under the mode dichotomy and determination of the natural state to one end-content class, good-generality requires the rational form, and in this encoding the countermodel shows that premise is needed; neither side accepts it at the root (the rival posits value-ranked modes; the classical side denies it through eminent containment yet affirms d1fb6414), so the separation does not apply there and the mode question returns to d1fb6414 / 3b40009e (analyst judgment, counted once). The kind rule gives the object premise only if the root's favouring is a rational appetite of the root, the disputed mode step itself; lane P's per-bearer cell 'natural (object D) versus rational (object the good)' is corrected to 'formal object for the bearer', with mode entering only through the kind rule. ORIGINAL_FINALITY_2 at one pair gives good-generality, so commitment (e) in sense 2, lane P's common value standard and this route are one assumption. e2357adc remains open; its per-bearer warrant is f2e8eb42. Strongest standing rival: the D-directed nature as a natural appetite with object D (the Fifth Way's intrinsic directive nature at a root, D-directed form); price: denies f2e8eb42 and, given variation, must locate value (in its nature with an unrecorded fixity to D, independent, or produced). Relocation, not discrimination; no premise is established.
current_assessment.next_test: Where the value order is grounded for the D-rival, with the three loci priced; whether 'a nature's favouring follows the ordering its nature grounds' has warrant independent of E 9281317d; a root-level determination-to-one-end premise with simplicity as input; whether the classical root's apprehension of candidates is grounded in its self-apprehension (connecting the wisdom route to the apprehension state the fixer law requires). Per the three-angles rule, move horizontally unless one of these yields a new mode- or object-coordinate argument.
